scope: Master4008 source candidates + independently qualified Core370 style reference; evidence-specific, not a universal accept/reject asset boolean

normalization.source_immutability: Never edit original bytes; all scene transformations in typed, reversible, immutable derivative with explicit SHA parent
normalization.object_to_iris: p_iris = N_world_to_iris * p_source_world; one global, invertible similarity transform
normalization.raw_source_unit: UNKNOWN until measured; normalized coordinates are unitless and must NOT be reported as meters
normalization.source_up_front: UNKNOWN unless independently source- or anatomy-courted; do not silently rotate alleged humanoid Y/Z
normalization.pose: SOURCE_BIND_REST__NO_ANIMATION, if proven; never force A/T pose for arbitrary winged, snake, quadruped or sideways-authored source
normalization.mirror_policy: No unrecorded reflection. Negative determinant requires explicit parity, triangle-winding, normals and attachment court
normalization.skin_policy: Do not silently renormalize broken weights or swap bone order; exact sparse vertex-joint IDs preserved and independently tested
normalization.bone_policy: Propagate world/source/rest matrices and deform-bone/control-bone/constraint graph correspondence unchanged
normalization.animation_policy: seconds using exact rational fps timebase, retain native frame/take provenance, no synthetic clips counted as source
normalization.attachments_policy: Preserve parent object, bone socket, local and world transforms before and after pose; no welded mesh substitute
normalization.materials_policy: original material, texture, UV, alpha mode, color space and linear/sRGB decoding remain separately typed
normalization.quaternion_policy: Canonical wxyz order; source native convention recorded and converted only with reversible explicit mapping
normalization.camera_policy: ONE_FIXED_COMMON_CENTER_EXTENT_EIGHT_VIEW_GEOMETRY_COURT; per-view zoom only style diagnostic, NEVER source-camera truth
normalization.pixel_policy: Top-left raster origin, explicit pixel-center and projection/ray, image/camera/source matrices SHA bound
normalization.normal_policy: Inverse-transpose normal transform and parity check
normalization.occlusion_policy: Visibility, alpha support, ray depth and layer draw order never inferred solely from geometry silhouette

standardization.canonical_asset_id: immutable identity distinct from model views, clips, styles and outfits
standardization.source_sha256: SHA256 original source bytes; no transcoding identity laundering
standardization.source_identity_cluster: dedup group; original subject identity and protected split lineage
standardization.tensor_encoding: float32/float64 known units, finite; int64 indices; boolean valid mask; no zero-filled UNKNOWN
standardization.topology: face->source mesh object/vertex indices and original polygon identity retained; no silent decimation/retriangulation to teacher
standardization.rig: source observed bone/constraint/control IDs and full graph; no inferred IK from animation-ready export
standardization.skin: sparse influence per source vertex, exact bind and rest/bone mapping
standardization.semantic: separate source-face supported label, candidate name hint, human reviewed designed prior and unknown masks
standardization.graphics: SOURCE_NATIVE_RGBA separate from STYLIZED_2D_GAME_ART_RGB; stylized target must be reviewed against Core370 art domain
standardization.motion: source action IDs and curve times, not clip count as subject count

quality.legal: original creator and license snapshot required; all commercial ML training rights independently reviewed; Mixamo excluded; generated source assets excluded
quality.dedup: hash + perceptual/geometry lineage and publisher provenance; source identity split preserved across derivatives
quality.privacy: do not expose private source URLs/content in public logs
quality.security: untrusted Blender files in disposable sandbox, disabled autoexec, no elevated access, resource bound and content hash
quality.review_sampling: stratified morphology/provider/style/control, rare high-risk examples overrepresented; blinded held-out audits
quality.replay: versioned parser, Blender version, shader, policy and original-source SHA; readback report and exact parent hashes
quality.quarantine: failed or unknown source attributes never repaired into silent positive teacher labels

transfer: filter large source candidate set with explicit high-quality and canonicalization rules
multi-view RGB/depth/normal/semantic renders with exact camera and layer identities
produce human-understandable semantic disjoint target variants and face-bound masks
separate global body semantics from fine head/face evidence if native source supports it
separate original layered appearance evidence from visually completed/artificial hidden content
standardize multi-modal inputs at teacher interface
do_not_transfer: humanoid-only A-pose normalization to unrelated morphology
VRoid material name heuristic as ground-truth generic semantic label
generative occluded texture completion as original source evidence
implicit semantic layers as proof of native mechanical IK/skin
stdgen_plus_reference.audit_refresh_trigger: On relevant new StdGEN++ source/paper/dataset updates, revisit mapping before modifying semantic/graphics truth builder; explicit versioned changes only

materialization.blocked_until: all required per-head independent courts, source legal rights, lineage-safe splits, reversible normalization proof and representation-specific target masks PASS
